title: My Brilliant Friend
author: Elena Ferrante
summary: Growing up in a poor neighbourhood of 1950s Naples, two girls, the cautious narrator Elena and the fierce, brilliant Lila, form a close, rivalrous friendship that pulls them apart and together as they grow.
readIf: you want a deeply observed, intimate story of female friendship and ambition.
skipIf: you want a quick plot, or a story that resolves in one volume; this starts a series.

pairings.reason: Another story about sisterly closeness and ambition, much gentler and more hopeful.
Another novel that follows people from poverty through shifting decades.
A modern, spare novel about the pull between two very different people from the same place.
